_comment: Ranges for the RAM snapshots that close the dynamic half of issue #23.
Produced by brief C2 from the static survey (tools/ram_survey.py,
re/findings/ram.md).  C3's logger reads each range with KWP RequestUpload
0x35 + TransferData 0x36 (62 data bytes per block, kwp.md 5) and writes one
file per session in the format tools/ram_snapshot_diff.py documents.
0x7F9E3C-0x7FA47F is left out on purpose: kwp_upload_range_check (0x0A3160)
answers NRC 0x31 for any request that overlaps it.
Sessions to record, in this order: key-on, idle (engine running, warm),
after a drive, then key-off/key-on three times.  Compare with

excluded.why: KWP protected window, RequestUpload answers NRC 0x31 (kwp.md 5.1)

ranges.why: internal SRAM below the protected window
internal SRAM above the protected window, up to the old boot stack top
PRIORITY: stack floor 0x7FF01C-0x7FF3BF, task stack 0x7FF3C0-0x7FF76F and the recommended patch region 0x7FF770-0x7FFFEB
external SRAM, second half; 0x804800-0x807FFF is the KWP programming copy's destination

priority_ranges.why: RECOMMENDED patch RAM. Must be blank (0x00 or 0xFF) and unchanged in every session, or the placement is wrong.
fallback block; must be shown not to be a second stack
stack. Measures the real low-water mark and so validates the 0x5D0 B static estimate.
the only external SRAM the cold start does not clear; expected to hold the previous programming session's leftovers
